title: Ethereal Light Vortex
description: An abstract composition featuring glowing white and pale blue concentric rings and swirling brushstrokes that curve around a bright, luminous central void. Delicate sparkles, light streaks, and soft pastel smudges in gold and pink drift throughout the misty, overexposed background.
